purpose: Approximate v17-era spawn positions for six IoD HZ-213 quest-giver NPC templates that exist in NpcData_213 (v31/v92) but have zero TerritoryData spawns in either era. Groundwork for authoring TerritoryData_213 spawns to be tuned in-game.
primary_source: v17.11 client StrSheet_NpcLoc-00000.xml (D:/dev/tera/tera-dc-17_11/DataCenter_Final_USA/StrSheet_NpcLoc). Each of the six templates carries exactly one quest-marker coordinate keyed by huntingZoneId=213 + templateId. The '13#' prefix in each string is the IoD world-map region-string id (region 13), not a section id; the x,y,z after '#' is the marker world position.
coordinate_note: Positions are x,y,z world units. Heading/direction is not carried by NpcLoc and the six templates are unspawned in v17 TerritoryData (no authored heading exists), so dir is null and must be set when authoring, then tuned in-game.
section_naming_source: Point-in-polygon of each marker against v92 server AreaData_13_ATW_Death_P.xml <Section> fences; names via section-mapping.json.
collision_source: D:/dev/mmogate/tera92/server/Datasheet/TerritoryData_213.xml (51 Npc spawn entries; none reference the six templates).
v31_client_absence: Z:/tera pserver/v31.04/client-dc_v31/DataCenter_Final_EUR_v31/StrSheet_NpcLoc-00000.xml has 26 HZ-213 entries; none of the six templates are present (absent as expected).

npcs.sectionV92: 13030 Timeless Woods (container); 2500u from Dulari's Camp 13032 centroid
npcs.sectionMethod: inside 13030 Timeless Woods fence, not inside Dulari's Camp 13032 polygon; nearest camp centroid Dulari's Camp 2500u; nearest baseline NPC 1114 Helier (Guard) 1570u
npcs.discrepancy: v17 marker falls in the Timeless Woods container polygon on the approach to Dulari's Camp (2500u from camp centroid, 1570u from a Dulari's Camp guard), not inside the Dulari's Camp section polygon the wiki names. Data-derived position kept; recommend authoring at the v17 marker and nudging toward Dulari's Camp during in-game tuning if it reads as too far out.
